outcome: Abnormal perfusion of fetal blood vessels
Elevated SARS-CoV-2 IgG/IgM antibodies in umbilical cord blood (vertical infection)
cohort: The study participants were pregnant women with COVID-19 and their newborns, as pooled from analyzed research.
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection in pregnant women leads to various pregnancy and neonatal complications, including significant placental damage characterized by macrophage infiltration and vascular abnormalities, with evidence of vertical infection.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was reported as the most common pregnancy complication, occurring in 80% of cases.
